episodes.synopsis: Anna wants to help Kyotaro since he has a broken arm, but she's unaware of the secret he's keeping from her.
episodes.title: We're Searching

episodes.synopsis: It's the first time Kyotaro has ever been in Anna's home, so he's naturally left feeling like a bundle of nerves and anxiety.
episodes.title: I'm Growing Up

episodes.synopsis: Valentine's Day is a week away, and Kyotaro finds himself roped into making chocolates with Anna and her friends. But complications arise when Moeko claims Kyotaro as her bae.
episodes.title: Yamada and Me

episodes.synopsis: Valentine's Day chocolates hold a special meaning, and Anna wants to know what they mean to Kyotaro.
episodes.title: Yamada Likes…

episodes.synopsis: Despite all the time Kyotaro has spent with Anna, he discovers that there is so much more he doesn't know about her. More importantly, he realizes he wants to change that.
episodes.title: I Want to Know

episodes.synopsis: As the student rep, Kyotaro faces the unenviable task of delivering the graduation speech. Now he'll need a dose of confidence and a little help from Anna to pull it off.
episodes.title: Yamada Likes Me

episodes.synopsis: The implications and meanings of Anna's indirect confession leave Kyotaro reeling. He may not know what will happen next, but he knows he cannot afford to mess this up.
episodes.title: We're Overflowing

episodes.synopsis: The school year is ending. With a window of opportunity closing, Kyotaro reaches a decision: if he can make this shot in a basketball game against Anna, he’ll ask her out.
episodes.title: We Stayed Up All Night

episodes.synopsis: Kyotaro discovers an obsessed fan is spreading rumors online that Anna has a boyfriend. Knowing what that means for both her safety and career, he cannot help but worry.
episodes.title: We Made a Promise

episodes.synopsis: A new school year means a new class and new friends. Unfortunately, it also means new challenges to Kyotaro and Anna's evolving situationship.
episodes.title: I Want to Be Closer to Yamada

episodes.synopsis: Kyotaro wants nothing to do with the sports festival this year, but all that changes when Sho challenges him to a one-on-one in the cavalry battle.
episodes.title: I Don't Want to Lose

episodes.synopsis: The class is excited for the upcoming school trip, except for Anna, who is no longer acting like herself. Kyotaro wonders what it means, not realizing that she made a choice.
episodes.title: I Want to Tell Her

episodes.synopsis: Anna and Kyotaro's bond is teetering between friendship and romance. Perhaps this time the scales will tip and Kyotaro can finally tell Anna the words she wishes to hear.
episodes.title: I, We, Fell in Love
